verdict.rationale: Channel3 ships a /v1 path-versioned API with a dated semver changelog and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, so developers do get a versioned, published schema. It also lets UCP-capable agents connect to its catalog. However, no conformance or validation tooling is evidenced; the Try-it playground only runs requests against the production API. The OpenAPI info block also carries framework defaults rather than a product version. missing for 10: conformance/validation tooling, a versioned protocol spec (versus a proprietary API schema), a versioning/notice-window policy page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling

citations.quote: Channel3 publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (48 paths plus 5 webhooks, production server https://api.trychannel3.com)
If your agent already supports UCP, connect it to Channel3's global catalog for product search and lookup across stores.
